summary: Cerro Pelon, Rio Arriba County NM: a shelter-type lookout that FFLA lists as gone; no history or site description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association. No source read describes the site now.

evidence.supports: Listing: Cerro Pelon, Rio Arriba County, type Shelter, status Gone
evidence.quote: Rio Arriba Cerro Pelon 36.02676 -106.59591 Shelter Gone

evidence.supports: Listing: separate Tree 73/Cerro Pelon (north) map board, status Gone
evidence.quote: Rio Arriba Tree 73/Cerro Pelon (north) 36.12173 -106.39640 Map Board Gone

corrections.why: The FFLA listing gives the type as Shelter.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLA county listing was read. No detail page, build date, builder, staffing or fire record was found in the sources I could read. Searches did not tie the site to a national forest. An NRHP record that came up is for a different cabin (Ortega, Victor, Cabin, Carson NF) and is not used. Wikipedia's Cerro Pelon Ranch is an unrelated Santa Fe County estate. Cerro Pelado is a separate active Santa Fe NF lookout and must not be confused with this site. Brief kind 'ground' conflicts with the listing's 'Shelter'.
